scope: Only existing canonical Poaceae name, rank, authored synonym, concept, and hybrid holds. No canonical card enrichment, media, lessons, installation, county-native audit, Pages, or schedules.

scientific_decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP accepts this as a Poaceae species, not a variety of T. flavus; canonical name and authorship match.
POWO/WCVP accepts purpletop as a distinct Poaceae species; canonical name and authorship match.
The individual POWO species record explicitly accepts Texas tridens at species rank; WFO corroborates. Do not infer rejection from omission in POWO genus list.
Homotypic basionym listed by POWO; preserve as historical alias only.
Homotypic combination under white tridens, not separate accepted species.
Homotypic basionym of purpletop in POWO; author is required for exact mapping.
Homotypic basionym of Texas tridens, published 1883; no second card.
POWO accepts Chapman’s tridens separately from T. flavus; historical purpletop variety concepts must not be blindly merged.
POWO lists this historical variety as homotypic synonym of accepted T. chapmanii, not T. flavus.
POWO accepts a distinct named hybrid with formula T. flavus × T. strictus; this does not assign hybrid origin to any learner photograph.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Three existing canonical Tridens learner species
scientific_decisions.reason: Direct POWO records accept T. albescens, T. flavus, and T. texanus separately; keep existing canonical concepts, no renames or duplicate installs.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Proposed blanket synonymization of Tridens flavus var. chapmanii into Tridens flavus
scientific_decisions.reason: The cited variety maps to separately accepted T. chapmanii in POWO. FAIL applies to proposed merge only, not the existing accepted purpletop species.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Identity of individual photographs assigned to the three Tridens cards
scientific_decisions.reason: Taxon-name acceptance and historical synonym mappings do not authenticate any particular photographed plant. Preserve all provisional specimen/photo identity holds; no media edits.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Hybrid ancestry of any individual photographed Tridens specimen
scientific_decisions.reason: Accepted T. × oklahomensis formula does not prove a learner specimen is that hybrid; preserve existing hybrid/science holds and do not invent parents.

scientific_decisions.source_name: POWO Tridens genus accepted-species listing versus accepted T. texanus species page
scientific_decisions.reason: The POWO genus page says 13 accepted species and omits T. texanus while its direct species page explicitly marks it accepted; WFO also accepts T. texanus. Treat as source-index discrepancy, not evidence for renaming or rejection. Needs Kew backbone reconciliation.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Historical purpletop varieties or unidentified Tridens records without voucher
scientific_decisions.reason: Older use of T. flavus var. chapmanii and unauthenticated Tridens records requires specimen/concept checking before attaching to any installed card; name mapping alone cannot resolve source-observation identity.

limitations: WCVP/POWO direct species pages were inspected; Kew genus aggregate list omits T. texanus despite accepting it on its species page. No backend database record or Kew staff confirmation was obtained.
Individual learner photos, vouchers and hybrid ancestry were not independently authenticated; specimen-level holds remain.
Flora of North America volume 25 and primary grass treatments are cited as accepted-name supporting authorities by POWO; full original taxonomic treatments were not reexamined here.
No county nativity audit was undertaken.
